title: Onboarding template assets: reference app screenshots & README flow diagrams
creator: Ava Patel
description: Create a cohesive set of visual assets and README diagrams for the new Template Apps landing and each reference app (Chat Assistant, Semantic Search, Code Helper). Deliverables: hero screenshots (light/dark), annotated UI callouts for key UX patterns, step-by-step README flow diagrams (SVG + PNG), and automated screenshot generation script for CI. Assets should match console visual style, include accessible alt text, and be organized for docs and marketing reuse.
acceptance_criteria: Hero screenshots for 3 template apps in both light and dark themes (1920x1080 PNG + 1200x628 thumbnails)
README flow diagrams for onboarding flow: Walkthrough, API wiring, and deploy steps (editable SVG + exported PNG)
Annotated callouts (max 6 per app) exported as separate overlay PNGs and included in design tokens file
Puppeteer script + GitHub Actions job added to repo to generate screenshots from the running template app (docs/screenshots/automation.md)
Design QA completed: color contrast, copy accuracy, and localization placeholders verified
Files uploaded to Drive with naming convention: TEMPLATE-{app}-{theme}-{variant}.{ext} and referenced in the PR
